capabilities: filter new arXiv papers against user-defined research topics and directions
generate a daily report note of up to 20 papers grouped by topic
create longer per-paper notes on demand or by arXiv ID
schedule runs inside Obsidian or via CLI/cron
optionally index personal PDFs and send an email digest
extras: Also ships as a standalone CLI + browser workbench and a DeepSeek Harness sidebar plugin; Obsidian and CLI configuration values and API keys do not synchronize. Detailed setup guides (Getting Started, CLI reference) live in external documentation. The manifest carries an unreviewed-plugin notice.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to follow new arXiv output, filter it to your research directions, and turn it into structured daily notes.

relations.evidence: a DeepSeek Harness (DSH) extension that work without Obsidian
a short digest after a successful day (your Resend key, or Official delivery Beta)

summary: Daily arXiv tracker that filters new papers by your research topics and writes LLM-summarized daily reports and per-paper notes into the vault.
